'''Brio Tabbett''' was an individual who was to be a witness against suspected [[Gangster/Legends|gangster]] [[Wolga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. However, before [[Gender/Legends|he]] testified, [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] broke into Tabbett's apartment and either abducted or disintegrated Tabbett.
